changelog:
1. App Renamed to 'Internet Call': Professional WhatsApp-style clean interface
2. Hidden Raw IPs: Replaced confusing technical IP addresses with clean Online (Wi-Fi) / Online (Mobile Data) and Calling Numbers
3. Public & Scalable: Unlimited contacts and customizable Calling Numbers for any Android phone
4. In-App Updates: Fully declared REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES for reliable 1-click updates
5. Cross-Network Audio: IMA-ADPCM 4:1 audio compression enables crystal-clear voice across 4G/5G mobile carriers and Wi-Fi
